stops.title: Grant, Nɔto Jɔb Nem
stops.caption: Wan rol, tay to wan ples.
stops.speech: Pamishɔn kɔmɔt frɔm grant: wan rol we dɛn nem, tay to wan branch, wan fɛloship, wan dipatmɛnt, ɔ di ol chɔch.

stops.title: Gi Wan
stops.caption: Gi am, ɛn i wok wantɛm.
stops.speech: Gi wan grant ɛn dat pɔsin de si di ɛkstra sɛkshɔn dɛn wantɛm. Pul am ɛn i stɔp, bɔt dɛn istri de de.
